$comment: Where a Kotlin value lands in an HTML string, judged by what interpolate admits there and by what the analysis can see of the value: a number that may be null, markup in an attribute, a branch of an if or a when, and the fixes that are safe. The format is kotlin.json's.

cases.name: a nullable number in element text is silent
a nullable number in a quoted attribute is silent
a nullable number at the start of a URL is silent
a nullable number joined with + in element text is silent
a nullable number in style is refused
a nullable boolean in a Datastar expression is refused
a nullable number in a JavaScript string Datastar runs is refused
a boolean in style is refused and a number is not
cases.source:
fun f(b: Boolean, n: Int) = "

"

cases.name: markup in a quoted attribute is characters that can end it

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate fun f(h: Html) = interpolate("

", h).text

cases.name: markup in a URL whose start settles the scheme is a warning

fixes: import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate fun f(h: Html) = interpolate("x", h).text

cases.name: markup in a tag name is a warning
Trusted in element text is markup
Trusted in an attribute is a warning the interpolate fix cannot help
an interpolate call in an attribute is a warning

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate fun f(q: String) = interpolate("

", interpolate("%s", q)).text

cases.name: the text of an Html in element text is markup
the text of an Html in an attribute is a warning

fixes:
import io.github.markusaugust.streamlord.core.domain.interpolate fun f(h: Html) = interpolate("

", h.text).text

cases.name: a number in a tag name is a hint, and its end tag says nothing
a boolean in an attribute name is a hint
an unquoted value is quoted by the fix
an unquoted value in a raw string is quoted whole
a number in an unquoted value is a hint with the same fix
an unquoted value with a quote of its own is not quoted
an if with a String branch is a String

fixes:

%s

", if (b) "x" else q).text

cases.name: an if between numbers in style is a number
cases.source:

"

cases.name: an if with a branch that may be null in style is refused

"

cases.name: a when between literals is the author's own
a when with a String branch is a String

fixes:

%s

", when (n) { 0 -> "none"; else -> q }).text

a value that may be null keeps the interpolate fix away
a String that may be null keeps the interpolate fix away
a number in a Datastar expression keeps the interpolate fix
